svg.aria-label: Prologue: a portrait of Klim Kassymkhan. Backend developer, Python first. Now: building SMM Radar, Telegram analytics, private beta; shipped Flavor Tree for OneIdea 2026 × Efes; studying Software Engineering at KBTU, final years; open to Internships · freelance backend · hackathons; also SEO · public speaking, several years each.
